openwrt_wiki.einleitung: Xiaomi AX3200 (model RB01, international version) and Redmi AX6S (model RB03, Chinese version) are exactly the same hardware. The only difference is the version of the stock firmware (which is region locked).
openwrt_wiki.warnung_bootloader: Recent models ship with a newer bootloader that has been known to cause a soft-brick after 6 reboots. (Abschnitte 'Commands to run post-install to prevent soft-brick after 6 reboots')
openwrt_wiki.warnung_produktion_12_2023: Xiaomi AX3200 Production Date after 12/2023 with telnet disabled, will brick after flash Sysupgrade image (23.05.3 still fail), factory image can fail sometime ... it request mod uboot layout
openwrt_wiki.installation_kurz: Erstinstallation braucht Telnet-Zugang zur Stock-Firmware (fruehe Geraete ab Werk, RB03 per Closed-Beta-Stock-Firmware 1.2.7, RB01 nur ueber UART- bzw. netmode-4-Wege); dann OpenWrt factory.bin per mtd. Details siehe Wiki-Seite.
openwrt_wiki.known_issue_1: some newer AX3200/AX6S can only flash factory image ... mtd partitions are offset with -0x20000 (Pruefung: hexdump /dev/mtd8, fw_printenv boot_fw0/boot_fw1)
openwrt_wiki.known_issue_2: sometimes 5G wireless is not available in Luci after sysupgrade following factory image installation
openwrt_wiki.upgrade_24_10: Upgrading from 23.05 and earlier to 24.10 or snapshot: neues Layout, factory.bin noetig (siehe Commit a6991fc)
openwrt_wiki.debricking: Xiaomi-Recovery: Reset beim Einschalten halten (~10 s, orange LED blinkt schnell), PC 192.168.31.100 mit DHCP+TFTP an LAN-Port, Datei <Router-IP hex>.img (z. B. C0A81F02.img) = Stock-Firmware passender Region; blaue LED blinkt = ok, lila = falsches Format. Bei manchen Versionen geht dieser Weg nicht, dann UART.
openwrt_wiki.failsafe: "The button" ... is the 'reset'-button at the back, inside the hole, and not the easier to reach "WPS"-button close to it. The "lan1"-port ... is the one LAN port out of the three that is closest to the yellow "WAN" port on the back.
openwrt_wiki.netzwerk_default: br-lan: lan1, lan2, lan3 (192.168.1.1/24); wan: DHCP/DHCPv6
openwrt_wiki.wed: built-in MediaTek mt7915 card, that is supporting WED (Wireless Ethernet Dispatch); auf MT7622 nur TX-Richtung
openwrt_wiki.serial: Through-holes on top-right of board, next to reset button, labelled J1. Pins are VCC, RX, GND, TX from left to right, starting from the hole labelled 1 on the silkscreen. Terminal headers can be attached, but may be awkward to solder due to the antenna leads not allowing free movement of board from inside the case. Serial connection parameters: 3.3V, 115200, 8N1
openwrt_wiki.serial_ohne_oeffnen: it's possible to reach the serial terminals without opening the case (Hinweis tgabor, Forum #612; Foto media:xiaomi:ax3200_serial_access_with_pins_large.jpg); CAREFUL! Take extra care not to short circuit the pins
openwrt_wiki.gehaeuse_oeffnen: Remove the sticker/label on the bottom of the device to reveal two screws. Unscrew these and use a plastic spudger or pry-tool in order to remove the top cover ... optionally remove the five screws fastening the heat-spreader
openwrt_wiki.notes: DC power barrel plug dimensions 4.0mm x 1.7mm.

openwrt_git.betreff: mediatek: Add support for Xiaomi Redmi Router AX6S
openwrt_git.text: Also known as the "Xiaomi Router AX3200" in western markets. SoC: MediaTek MT7622B; RAM: DDR3 256 MiB (ESMT M15T2G16128A); Flash: SPI-NAND 128 MiB (ESMT F50L1G41LB or Gigadevice GD5F1GQ5xExxG); WLAN: 2.4/5 GHz 4T4R; 2.4 GHz: MediaTek MT7622B; 5 GHz: MediaTek MT7915E; Ethernet: 4x 10/100/1000 Mbps; Switch: MediaTek MT7531B; LEDs/Keys: 2/2 (Internet + System LED, Mesh button + Reset pin); UART: Marked J1 on board VCC RX GND TX, beginning from "1". 3.3v, 115200n8; Power: 12 VDC, 1.5 A
openwrt_git.notes: U-Boot passes through the ethaddr from uboot-env partition, but also has been known to reset it to a generic mac address hardcoded in the bootloader. bdata is also populated with the ethernet mac addresses ... used instead.
openwrt_git.reverting_to_stock: Stock Xiaomi recovery tftp that accepts their signed images, default ips 192.168.31.1 + 192.168.31.100, image named as tftp server ip in hex (Eg. C0A81F64.img), triggered by holding reset pin on powerup.

openwrt_git_ubi_loader.betreff: mediatek: mt7622: add a second u-boot for redmi-ax6s
openwrt_git_ubi_loader.text: The vendor u-boot knows nothing about UBI ... This commit changed the flash layout and added a second u-boot where the kernel supposed to be. Now the vendor u-boot chainloads our mainline u-boot, and our u-boot reads kernel+rootfs from UBI ... Procedure for flashing from vendor firmware shouldn't change.
